def path(R,C,narms=16):
    cells=[(R,C)]
    r,c=R,C
    dirs=[(-1,0),(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1)]
    d=0; arm=2
    for i in range(narms):
        dr,dc=dirs[d%4]
        for _ in range(arm):
            r+=dr; c+=dc
            cells.append((r,c))
        d+=1
        if i%2==1: arm+=2
    return cells
